rock: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE seamless square top-down rocky ground texture for a cozy MapleStory-inspired pixel cartoon farming/survival RPG. This is an intermediate to be reduced to a 64x64 pixel tile; FOUR adjacent 64px tiles form one 128px game terrain block, so texture features MUST be large and quiet. Across this single square show only 5 to 7 broad irregular flat granite stone plates embedded in warm gray-brown compact earth, stone diameters 25% to 40% of the square width. Rounded angular shapes, 3 restrained cel shaded tone regions per stone, upper-left light. Cool muted gray slate stones, warm taupe dirt joints, low contrast. Natural wilderness rocky soil, not pavement, not brick, not a cobblestone road, not separate standing boulders. A few short wide cracks, broad uncluttered flat areas. Tileable continuous edges on all four sides, stones crossing borders. Orthographic directly overhead ground plane, NO perspective, NO horizon, NO vignette, NO cast shadow, NO UI, NO grid, NO border, NO text. Crisp large pixel clusters, clean stepped contour and shading bands, palette about 12 colors. Absolutely no speckle noise, no fine pebbles, no grains, no tiny repeated sparkles, no photographic texture, no micro detail. Fully opaque texture filling entire square.
snowInitial: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE seamless square top-down snow ground texture for a cozy MapleStory-inspired pixel cartoon farming/survival RPG. This intermediate will be reduced to 64x64 pixels. Four neighboring 64px tiles form one 128px game terrain block, so use very large readable terrain features, not granular snow. A soft blanket of clean off-white powder snow, with only 3 or 4 very broad shallow wind-carved rounded drift bands, each spanning 35% to 65% of the square width. Most area quiet near-white flat surface. Subtle blue-gray shadows below the drifts, icy pale cyan midtone, creamy white upper-left highlights, restrained 6 to 10 color cel shading. Cozy winter ground that players can walk on, no standing snowballs, no ice rocks. Drift shapes flow across borders seamlessly. Seamless tiling left to right and top to bottom. Top-down orthographic ground plane filling entire square. Crisp broad pixel clusters and stepped organic contour edges. Fully opaque. No sparkle, snowflake symbol, stars, stipple, grain, noise, dots, fine short strokes, microtexture, grass, dirt, footprints, objects, border, grid, text, horizon, perspective, vignette, photographic material or 3D render. Large quiet shapes, low contrast.
